subject: event.dataTransfer.setDataImage() doesn't seem to work in the built-in RStudio shiny browser

messages.author: a60d28d0ae3bdda8
messages.subject: event.dataTransfer.setDataImage() doesn't seem to work in the built-in RStudio shiny browser
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to set a drag image for an HTML object within a Shiny app.

I'm using event.dataTransfer.setDataImage(,,) within the dragStart event handler to set the custom ghost image.

This works perfectly when I run the Shiny app in Firefox, but doesn't work when I run it in the built-in Shiny browser.

Is there any way I can detect whether I'm running within the built-in browser or within a standard browser? I prefer using the built-in browser most of the time -- it appears as a smaller window, and stops the App when I close the window instead of having to close the browser tab and then also stop the app as a separate step within R -- but I can't use it when the dragImage failure crashes the JavaScript.

Thanks very much

Louise
